name: AZ-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by about four points on the partisan baseline
Incumbent Greg Stanton runs with a large cash advantage ($2.0M on hand vs $0.3M for Jasser)
Prediction markets price Stanton near 95% to win
No independent outside spending against Stanton
model.rationale: Stanton combines incumbency, a Democratic-leaning Phoenix-area district, and a dominant fundraising position, while challenger Zuhdi Jasser has raised comparatively little and drawn no outside support. Markets and fundamentals both point to a comfortable double-digit Democratic win.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Stanton or an unusually favorable Republican turnout environment could narrow the margin, though an upset remains unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Stanton seeks a fourth term in this Democratic-leaning Phoenix-area district, where the partisan baseline favors Democrats by about four points and recent environments have added to that edge. He enters the general election with roughly $2.0 million on hand after raising over $2.1 million, with no outside groups opposing him.

Republican Zuhdi Jasser has raised about $565 thousand and trails badly in cash, with no measurable outside backing. Prediction markets give Stanton roughly a 95% chance of winning. With no public polling available, the forecast rests on fundamentals and money, both of which point to a comfortable Stanton victory in the double digits.
